headline: Anthropic's Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
snapshot: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
